name: Guy Yuzak
source:
[i]"If we let a traitor go, it sets a bad example. You'll make a great lesson, you two."[/i]

[i]Obstructer of Freedom[/i]

Biying's subordinate who's assigned to supervise the Taozhe district. The residents of Taozhe view him as a tyrant.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
